description_text:
High detailed model created by SQUIR team.
Ready to render at 3dsmax.
Rendering scene with all lightning, materials, background setups is included only for 3dsmax2015But it will work also with newer versions of 3dsmax.
3dsmax 2010 format is also included, but without lightning/rendering studio setups and with standard materials only.
Other than 3dsmax files (3ds,fbx,lwo,c4d,obj) include only standard materials without advanced shadders or background setup.
All of our models was made on the 3dsmax, and we are able to provide uncollapsed modifier stack only for the 3dsmax. but if you'd need the lower polygon version at other programs, please contact with the support, and we will convert the reduced mesh to requested format. The lowest available meshsmooth level is shown at the wire view, next to the hipoly wire view.
For this product there's 3 different 3dsmax files included.Set is uncollapsed, it's a file where you can make changes at the model. Hipoly is collapsed to hipoly with all the modifiers history cleaned to make it trouble free  while using at other programsStudio is the file with all rendering setups that we used to make the previews renderings.
Because different computers have different disks topology, it might be necessary to change the textures patches on the destination computer.
Thank you for buying SQUIR models

description_text:
The Airbus A319 is a shorter variant of the Airbus A320. It is a twin jet passenger airliner in service since the late 1980s. It is a member of the A320 family of airliners produced by Airbus and has a single aisle configuration. It is the largest aircraft family to have a single aisle arrangement. The A320 can seat from 120 to 156 passengers and operates with a crew of 6-9.
These aircraft have a range of nearly 4000 miles. Over 1500 have been ordered and 1361 have been delivered. 1355 are now in operation.
This model is built near to scale and includes some exterior detail. It has animateable features including ailerons, flaps, elevators, rudder, turbines, landing gear retraction and landing gear doors. It is fully textured and comes with all materials and textures as shown here. This model is also available in more than 10 formats for your immediate downloading. Pick the one or two you want and download them.

description_text:
The Airbus A319 is a shorter variant of the Airbus A320. It is a twin jet passenger airliner in service since the late 1980s. It is a member of the A320 family of airliners produced by Airbus and has a single aisle configuration. It is the largest aircraft family to have a single aisle arrangement. The A320 can seat from 120 to 156 passengers and operates with a crew of 6-9.
These aircraft have a range of nearly 4000 miles. Over 1500 have been ordered and 1361 have been delivered. 1355 are now in operation.
This model is built near to scale and includes some exterior detail. It has animateable features including ailerons, flaps, elevators, rudder, turbines, landing gear retraction and landing gear doors. It is fully textured and comes with all materials and textures as shown here. This model is also available in more than 10 formats for your immediate downloading. Pick the one or two you want and download them.

description_text:
The single seat Cri-Cri is the smallest twin-engined aircraft in the world. It was designed in the 1970s by French aeronautical engineer Michel Colomban. It has a lightweight aluminum frame and sheet glued to Klegecell foam. It is one of the more successful homebuilt aircraft with many variations. It is a very stable aircraft and it's easy to fly. Despite its small size, it can handle cross-winds of up to 20 knots. It can continue to fly on one engine. If both engines fail, its lift-to-drag ratio is 11 to 1 and the rate of sink is about 2,5 m/s - this is comparable to most good light aircraft. Aerial acrobatics are handled with ease by experienced pilots.

description_text:
This car was almost the only commander car during most difficult first year of the war. Later it was substituted by Willys MA and MB.
This car originates from 1933 V8-40. In 1936 GAZ had has name of these times foreign minister V.M.Molotov, who 3 years later signed famous peaceful 'Molotov - Ribbentrop pakt' between Soviet Union and Germany. Letters M-1 means Molotov - model N:o 1. Among features of the car was rigid longeron frame with X-like cross-member, pushing strength have been transmitted to the frame by the pipe, contained cardan shaft. GAZ-M1 was the first soviet car with automatic ignition outstripping and back-forward adjstable front seats. This car is very famous and prevailing car of war times, it is mentioned even in this period songs. People called it 'Emka' for letter M in its name. Normal production ceased in 1941, but assembling from warehouse details continued a bit longer.Most of M-1 were on government service and only part of them became private later. Trophy cars, on the contrary, were private from the very beginning. That is why now M-1 is more rare than Opels or Mercedeses

description_text:
The Saxon was intended to act as a cheap but efficient battle-taxi for units that would have to make long journeys from the UK to reinforce the British Army of the Rhine. It was made as a relatively low cost armoured personnel carrier based on a revised Bedford M series 4x4 truck chassis and other commercially available components.[1] As a lightly armoured wheeled vehicle it is much faster - especially on roads - and easier to maintain than a tracked vehicle. Indeed, it shares many parts with commercial trucks, reducing the operating cost. It is armoured against small-arms fire and shell splinters, but is not intended to stand up to any anti-vehicle weaponry. The vehicle has a single machine gun for local air defence, and can carry up to ten men.
The Saxon's hull is welded steel with a V-shaped under-chassis plate to deflect mine detonations. Seating is provided in the rear for up to ten troops, although eight is a more comfortable load if all their equipment is included.[1] There is an equipment stowage area on the hull roof.[1]
Some Saxon IS, or Saxon Patrol, vehicles were acquired for service in Northern Ireland, serving both as troop carriers and used in riots with extendible wings to be used as protective shields as well as being used as ambulances. These have various minor modifications compared to the normal version, such as searchlights and wire cutters, intended for internal security operations.

A brougham pronounced broom or brohm was a light, four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage built in the 19th century. It was either invented for Scottish jurist Lord Brougham or simply made fashionable by his example. It had an enclosed body with two doors, like the rear section of a coach; it sat two, sometimes with an extra pair of fold-away seats in the front corners, and with a box seat in front for the driver and a footman or passenger. Unlike a coach, the carriage had a glazed front window, so that the occupants could see forward. The forewheels were capable of turning sharply. A variant, called a brougham-landaulet, had a top collapsible from the rear doors backward.
In 19th-century London, broughams previously owned and used as private carriages were commonly sold off for use as hackney carriages, often displaying painted-over traces of the previous owner's coat of arms on the carriage doors.
The special characteristics of the brougham bear a distinct similarity to the London Public Carriage Office's Conditions of Fitness for a vehicle intending to be licenced as a taxi cab.

description_text:
Reproduction of a 1st order Fresnel lens similar to the one used in St. Augustine Lighthouse, Florida.
The Optical System has an height of env. 3.5m and a 2m diameter (12' x 7').All prisms have been carefully aligned in order to project light horizontally from the lamp positioned in the Focus.
The Lantern System and their gears are Animated, actually turning clockwise, in order to directly use the model in existing lighthouse towers or far marine scenes.
No texture has been used in order to reduce model dimension.
Three kind of lights are used for the Lantern to have a faithfull result:- a ball object, positioned in the system focus, emitting in all directions through an emit material, useful to obtain mutual reflections inside the prism in daylight scenes,- an internal screen object limited by side screens lit, again, through an emit material, but in frontwise direction only, useful to have the lens system and prisms lit when looking to fhe lantern in night scenes,- one or a system of parallelely oriented volumetric spot lights representing the rotating beam, necessary also to lit far objects passing in front of the lighthouse.   The Lighthouse Tower shown in one of the Turntables is not supplied: it has been added from an other model of ours, sold under the name of Cape Aghulas Lighthouse.

description_text:
This is a highly detailed, normal mapped asset set for next generation games. It includes 162 unique roadsigns, with a second set of distressed maps to make up 324 signs.
With an average of 44 tris per sign, including bacface polygons and poles, these signs are easily implemented into any game engine. With or without normal maps, these signs are sure to impress and look fantastic in many rendering situations.
My screenshots were rendered out in Marmoset Toolbag, with 1024 Diffuse, Specular, and Normal.
Absolutely no postwork has been done other than the adding of text and compiling images together.
Included mesh file types are:
.ma    Maya 2010 Ascii
.mb    Maya 2010 Binary
.max   Max 2010
.obj    Lightwave standard
.fbx    Fbx 2010
All textures are included as 1024x1024 .Tga with alpha embed in the diffuse, and the specular and normals separate.
This pack is highly flexible, included is 3 types of standard poles, 1 bent type, and multiple dressing signs, such as "4 way stop", "North", and many others to dress up your scenes even more.
The signs do not have complicated uvs and work with backface culling. All backsides of signs are separate polygons with separate uvs.
No plug ins, no special renderers or extra items needed to use my signs.
If you have any questions, contact me through cg3delijah.com

description_text:
Ancient Roman Bridge Ba. Faithful and accurate Reconstruction. C4D, 3DS, OBJ, VUE6to13!
Roman Bridge Ba.Roman Stone Bridge Type 'Concordia Sagittaria' [Italy].
34 HD Textures, UVMaps and Alternate Textures.
Real World Scale Model [Real World System]. Quads [C4D; OBJ] & Tris [VUE;3DS].
SmartCgArt is member of the Archaeological Institute of America-AIA.
Faithful and accurate Reconstruction of a Roman Bridge Ba, as from remains and evidence.
The Inscription on the bridge is an original inscription from Concordia Sagittaria [1st century AD]: 'Manius Acilius Mani Libertus IIIIIIvir ordered [its] contruction in his will'.A Sevir was a public officer of high dignity, chosen among the richest Liberti [freed slave] of a local community.
In the package you will find:1- 1 complete HD Roman Bridge Ba;2- 34 Hi-Quality Hi-Def PhotoReal Textures [4096x4096; 4096x416; 2000x1290; 1932x744; etc.];3- Alternate Textures to create different types of elements;4- 2 UVMaps with UVTemplates to customize the Model;5- Real World Scale SmartCgArt Man Reference System with models [C4D, VUE, 3DS, OBJ, DXF].
All the Models are prepared Hi-DEF and Photoreal, perfect for any type of Rendering!
POLYGONS/VERTICES COUNTC4D-OBJ: only/mostly quads [30168; 30259]VUE-3DS: triangulated [48220; 30259]
Enjoy THE ARCHAEO.SYS 3D SERIES.
These models are useful for many types of sceneries, ancient sceneries but also modern ones, as for Roman re-enactment.
The Archaeo.Sys 3D series is developing high-fidelity 3D reconstruction of Objects, Architecture and Scenes from Classical Greek and Roman Antiquity.

The Boeing 307 was the first airliner designed with cabin pressurization making flights above 10,000 feet a capability.  
These airliners were the first four-engine Boeing airliner and were a development of the four-engine heavy bomber B-17C. The Wings, tail, stabilizers, engines, and landing gear were all identical to the B-17C. The Fuselage was a low drag aerodynamic circular shape allowing for the cabin pressurization to be efficiently incorporated. The cabin was over 12 feet wide. It was  designed as a luxurious airliner and was the state of the art for her day in 1935.  The airplane could routinely cruise at 20,000 feet allowing fewer weather delays and also the ability to fly above much bad weather.  It was also the first airliner requiring a flight engineer. She carried 33 passengers.

description_text:
This lowpoly brandless truck is ready to be put in any game engine like UE4, Unity, CryEngine, or even make realistic renders with any PBR render engine like Vray, Corona, Keyshot, Arnold, ect. It has openable doors and an interior. the Cistern is detachable just in case someone only need the cistern or the truck without the Cistern
!!!!!!! Substance Painter file INCLUDED !!!!!!!
if you need this model with different texture file format, resolution or just in case you want to change the color, add more or less dirt, rust or any texture variation here the editable substance painter file is included.
The model is splitted in 2 main different layout
The Truck textures with a resolution of 4096x4096 and with a Texel Density of 400px/m  this set includes(BaseColor, Metallic, Normals, AO, Roughness)
The Cistern textures with a resolution of 2048x2048 with 375px/m of Texel Density this set includes(BaseColor, Metallic, Normals, AO, Roughness)
it also has 2 more secundary layouts for glass and grill this one with a tilebalel, both has a resolution of 512x512 these set include(BaseColor, Opacity, Normals, Roughness, Metallic)
Chamfers of round corners of big objects were made using the weighted normals we can get from Autodesk Maya and for the bevels of small objects we used normal maps and straighten UVs as much as possible to avoid pixelated edges and maximize the quality of this asset.
We also included a different editable file in both formats 3ds max and FBx without weighted normals just in case anyone need to edit the goemetry
The model scale is in meter with realistic dimensions, it is placed in the world center and each animable object like wheels and doors has their proper pivot ready for rotation.

description_text:
GILOR Inquisitor remote probe station is a multisensor ultrabroad spectrum observation station with Optical, Infrared, LIDAR, AESA radar and Gamma illumination pods. Instituted as a station completely independent from the sensor suites of it's carrier vehicle, the Inquisitor carries its own energy source and a holodisplay. Built for the mobile command bridge standard, the Inquisitor provides a private for-your-eyes-only observation station, important for critical mission planning.

Two versions provided, Scanline with baked AO in UV2 and a more detailed Mental Ray version. The two versions differ slightly in details. Object is animated, materials are structured for good close-up detail, AO, bump and specular maps provided, HDR reflection. Mental Ray has adjustable AO-controlled dirt details texture. Floor of mobility bricks provided. Scene comes as seen in the previews, lense effects added in Photoshop. Poly count is for Mental Ray version.
Layered PSD files included for customisation.

3D Studio MAx 9 file.
Concept and design by the artist.

description_text:
The Scarab robotic platform is an electrical unmanned carrier vehicle. Boosted high frequency steppers for movement and steering guarantee millimeter precision positioning combined with good speed. 360-degree wheel rotation allows movement in any direction at any time. Running on replaceable fuel cells and capacitor grids, with a fast cycle capacitor recharge interface underneath the vehicle. Scarab is able to lift itself over smaller obstacles on the ground.  A linear laser LIDAR front and back maintains a free path. The Scarab is constructed from CompAl, a hypothetical mainstay 22nd century structural composite mix of duralium, stainless and carbon fiber, based on technical interannealing of metal and fiber.
Model is rigged to follow a user-controlled spline, with the wheels steering in the path direction. Three files provided: the Scarab following a path, the Scarab base unrigged mesh, the Scarab dismantled against a wall. PSDs included offer great customisation possibilites of dirt levels, bumpiness, reflectivity, colors.
Standard Max materials used, rendered in scanline mode with a raytraced light. Model is medium poly count, good for both realtime and renders. Model is adapted for realtime, with power of two textures, bump, detail, ambient occlusion and specular maps. AO is fully unwrapped in UV channel 2.
FBX format has simpler materials, OBJ and 3DS formats are basic mesh exports.
Concept and design by the artist. Model is not an industrial design and shouldn't be used as such.
3D Studio Max 9 file.

description_text:
3DRnB Scene 01- Mediterranean Courtyard  Exterior for Cinema 4D and VrayforC4D
Our target is always to give the best quality without any compromise in the creation of our assets. Therefore we have physically accurate shaders, high resolution textures, very detailed geometries, cameras and lights with physically correct values, and scenes and render settings that will guarantee the best balance between the final quality and speed of use.
We like to think that we are offering much more than a simple collection of assets like the many you can already find online, by studying these scenes you will have a chance to understand how to set your own workflow in order to obtain consistent results.
In these scenes, you will find many render settings. From the very fast one for previews, to the production ones that will give you the best balance speed/quality, to those high quality ones if you like results without any noise and don’t mind the time it takes to calculate it. 
Every scene will always have a PS post production file where you can observe how to modify the render in a fast and non-destructive way, an amazingly detailed pdf guide that will explain how we worked, which softwares and plugins we used and reasons behind certain decisions.
What’s included:
-Cinema 4D file (3D model, Vray cameras, lights and 56 shaders 100% DR ready) -High resolution textures -Post Production files (Photoshop CC required for best use) -Final images saved in jpeg format (Any photoshop can be used) -PDF Guide with tips and techniques regarding modeling, lighting, rendering and post-production (English and Italian language )
Requirements: The 3D Scene has been tested with C4D R.14, 15,16,17 on both Mac and PC Minimum requirements for optimal results is VrayforC4D 1.9.0.b (compatible with VrayforC4D 3.4 when available) Photoshop CC is recommended Hardware requirements: 8Gb RAM, 16Gb strongly recommend

description_text:
CITROEN GQ Concept detailed rigged 3D model with environment and lighting set, vray and standard materials.
CAR OVERVIEW
The Citroën GQ Concept was born through a unique partnership between the UK's market-leading quality men's monthly and a team of Citroën designers.
Dynamic performance and environmental responsibility were also key requirements for the project. The Citroën GQ Concept is powered by a plug-in Hybrid with a 1,598cc, 4-cylinder direct injection petrol engine offering a sporty 0-60mph time of just 4.5seconds, an electronically limited top speed of 155mph and CO2 emissions of just 80g/km.
TECHNICAL DETAILS
All parts carefully modeled on real reference pictures.
Wheels, body, doors, logos, cameras, environment, lights etc are grouped for an easy management of the scene.
1 HDRI
3D environment included.
Linear workflow gamma 2.2 optimized textures (max 2010)
WHEELS RIGGED
All parts are STILL EDITABLE, changing meshsmooth iterations this model become suitable for every kind of needs: realistic animations and super realistic stills.
Lighting and Vray physical cameras fully set to render exactly like the preview images, move the camera and just press Render.
.
All Materials and 4096x4096 textures included diffuse, specular, bump, displacement, opacity. Unwrapped UVs
Really easy to customize the car body texture and export in different formats.
12 textures in total
Max 9 format has both Vray and mentalray versions
Multiple formats: OBJ, FBX, C4D (car only)
The model is available also without the environment as separate product.
Thank you for reading

description_text:

description_text:
This 3d model is a low to medium polygon model with lots of detail.  It is built for video presentation of a model Saturn V.  The animation of this engine and the Saturn V rocket are in use in an animation of the Saturn V launch at the Huntsville based Space and Rocket Center.  The model uses simple textures and can be adapted to other spacecraft or sci fi projects you may have in mind.  This rocket motor is also included in our Saturn V models also available in our public sale libraries.  
The Rocketdyne F-1 Rocket engine remains the largest rocket engine ever produced.  It was designed in the late 1950s and used in the Apollo program for the Saturn V 1st stage section.  Five of these huge engines were used in the first stage of the Saturn V.  Each rocket would produce 1,746,000 lbf (vac) and 1,522,000 (sl)

description_text:
This high poly model is build very near to scale and in as much detail as possible for the use in video animations.  This model uses simple materials and requires no texture materials.  The model is geometrically detailed as possible and was developed with actual H-1 engines as a reference.  The model also includes a great amount of detail in turbines and pumps .  It could be used in animations of the historic Saturn 1 or 1B boosters or a Delta launch or you may use it in some sci fi project.  Please keep in mind our Saturn 1B rocket model is available in our publicly available 3d model library.  
The Saturn 1 and Saturn 1B used the H-1 engines in a cluster of 8 to lift the giant Saturn rocket and payload as the 1st stage of an Apollo program launch.  This rocket engine developed 205,000 lbs thrust.  After the conclusion of the use of Saturn 1 boosters many of these engines were left unused.  They were then revised and modified slightly to become the Rocketdyne RS-27 engine and used in the boosters for the Delta unmanned rocket launches beginning in 2000.

This design and animation was created in Blender, is also currently available in fbx/obj/dae/3ds and is ready to be converted and/or rendered into ANY SUPPORTED 3D PROGRAMME for the desired effect of the customer, ready to be used straight away in games/film/media. All texture maps have been utilised for a realistic depiction (ambient occlusion, specular, normal,displacement,diffuse etc). This model and animation is perfect for educational use, in visually showing those of the technological capability of this mechanism and in so doing the Song dynasty, but also as a generic archaic engineering piece and machine/mechanism. Model and entire scene environment included.
-PLEASE VIEW ANIMATION OF MECHANISM HERE: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xM8QSIFd1Xo&t=75s -
This multi-level and multi-purpose Ancient Hydraulic machine, specifically for working blacksmiths, converts Kinetic and Gravitational potential energy of running water into rotational power, later operating into cams, pistons, cogs, shafts, chain drives, Archimedes-screws, bellows & cranks from a single origin. My concept depicts the roots of the Industrial Revolution were centuries earlier than anticipated, adhering to the typology and technology of both Medieval Chinese works but also those similarly of the Medieval Near East (see works of Al Jazari). The Archimedes screw potentially shows elements of cultural transfer of Ancient Greek ideas towards the East (however could be independent evolutionism and not diffusion). Automatic bellows are included in my design attached to cranks allowing for high temperatures needed within the blast furnace for the smelting of iron (in effect a steam engine in reverse). In addition water is extracted for the cooling of metal alloys (or irrigation systems/livestock sustenance) from the rotating Archimedes-screw controlled and flows to differing heights. Rotating mill-stones crush the wheat and hammers sculpt with great force the still pliable metal instruments to shape (in addition to grain), both operated along a cam shaft and are all entirely operated from one point of hydraulic origin from the main water-mill. 
Entire design and animation created by Christopher Antoniou.

description_text:
High Quality PBR Robot
The provided model has been created inside of Autodesk Maya  (version 2016) - Textured and polypainted in Substance Painter 2 and rendered with different render engines ( Arnold By Solid Angle and Marmoset Toolbag 3 package).
PRODUCT DETAILS:

  - 20557 faces 

  - 21467 vertices 

  - Centered in the origin

  - Real size model 

  - ALL pieces can be separated from each other (legs, gears, hands, etc..)

  - Unwrapped UVs with NO overlapping 

  - Accurate representation of robot components (arms, legs, cable, etc...)

INCLUDED MATERIAL:

  - Maya scene file (version 2016) rendered in Arnold (version 4.2.13.4) with whitebox lighting setup (included)

  - Textures for Maya: all textures  (4096 X 4096)   exported from Substance and mapped to aiStandard shader

  - Additional Texture (not essential) representing Billboards / Card for the whitebox lighting setup (.exr format)

  - .fbx file format

  - .obj file format

  - Marmoset Toolbag 3 complete scene file: with all textured needed and setup of the lights

  - Textures for Marmoset using  SPEC / GLOSS workflow

SPEC / GLOSS  WORKFLOW (Marmoset scene file)

  - High Quality textures *Texture resolution (4096 X 4096) 

  - Diffuse Map 

  -  Specular Map 

  - Glossiness Map 

  - Normal Map

ADDITIONAL MAPS
  - Simple Emissive Map (4096 X 4096)
ARNOLD MAPS (for aiStandard shader)

  - High Quality textures 

  - Linear Workflow setup

  - Texture resolution (4096 X 4096) 

  - diffuse Map (mapped in the diffuse channel) 

  -  specular map (mapped in Arnold specular color)

  -  roughness map (mapped in Arnold roughness)

  - f0 map (mapped in Arnold Reflectance at normal)

  - Normal Map (mapped in Arnold Bump map rollout)

ADDITIONAL MAP
  - Simple Emissive Map (to be eventually mapped to Arnold Emission Rollout)
If you have any question feel free to contact me at:
jackfurneri1984@gmail.com

description_text:
Very accurate 3D model of Marcus Porcius Cato the Censor. Enjoy the fantastic details of this sculpture! The very best you can find! Rendered in Blender 2.72 with Cycles with 2 different materials (marble and old bronze) and high resolution textures, for very detailed photorealistic renderings. You can also use this two fantastic materials with your own models! This model require a 2.72 Blender built or higher. Different builts can give a little different results. This model is exported in .3ds, .fbx and .obj. Materials and only works in Blender, but textures are still usefull in other formats.
Marcus Porcius Cato (234 BC, Tusculum – 149 BC) was a Roman statesman, commonly referred to as Censorius (the Censor), Sapiens (the Wise), Priscus (the Ancient), or Major, Cato the Elder, or Cato the Censor, (to distinguish him from his great-grandson, Cato the Younger) known for his conservatism and opposition to Hellenization.
If you need to print this model, we have an higher resolution, ready to print version of this model. Check out our portfolio.

The Survolt is a small-sized racing car based on the concept car REVOLTe presented at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show. Because the car runs on battery power alone, it is classed as a zero-emissions vehicle.
The car has horizontal LED headlamps which have lower power consumption than traditional filament bulbs, important in a battery-operated vehicle.

MG has scooped a major design award with its stunning MG Icon concept car.

The MG Icon beat the Lamborghini Urus, Mercedes-Benz Concept Style Coupe and Concept C.

We have balanced familiar brand cues, such as the wide and powerful front end graphic interpretation and, as one would expect, with a strong focus on the unique MG octagon. 
The MG Icon clearly demonstrates a progressive and soulful British spirit and has a lithe and powerful stance – its proportion harmonised by feature lines interpreted from MG’s iconic greats.”
The MGB GT inspired rear with structural lamps mounted on top of haunched wings are another highly distinctive feature of the design. The MG Icon has a four ‘shell’ seat layout. The rear seats can fold down completely into the floor, making the compact SUV versatile and functional

description_text:
A very accurate model of a Land Rover Defender 90 Hard Top with a HIGHLY DETAILED INTERIOR  MODELED.

Star Wars U-Wing UT-60D
The UT-60D, also known as the U-wing, was a transport/gunship model manufactured by Incom Corporation and used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Used to drop troops into battle, and provide cover fire for them, U-wings featured at least one side door which could also be used as a viewport for a mounted blaster cannon. The wings of the UT-60D were retractable and could be positioned forward-facing or backward-facing depending on the situation.
The U-wing was created and developed for the 2016 Star Wars film Rogue One: A Star Wars Story.

Yamaha Tesseract high detailed rigged 3D model with with environment and lighting set, vray and standard materials.
BIKE OVERVIEW
The Yamaha Tesseract is a funky concept quad-bike which first went on display at the 2007 Tokyo Motor Show.
The Yamaha Tesseract is a hybrid powered vehicle, powered by both a v-twin engine and an electric motor.
The suspension and steering mechanism of the Tesseract is also worth mentioning. Yamaha have equipped the concept with 'dual-scythe' suspension which allows the vehicle to lean like a regular two-wheeled bike. When stationary the extra pair of wheels and a dual arm-lock system keep the Tesseract upright.
TECHNICAL DETAILS

Wheels, body, dumpers, logos, cameras, environment, lights etc are grouped for an easy management of the scene.

Lighting and 4 cameras fully set to render exactly like the preview images, move the camera and just press Render.
.

1192487 polygons
1212289 vertices

124728 vertices
All Materials and 4096x4096 textures included diffuse, specular, bump, displacement. Unwrapped UVs
Really easy to customize the car body texture and export in different formats.
13 textures in total
Environment map is around 14000x2000
C4D, OBJ and FBX contains the bike only.
The model is available also without the environment as separate product.

SD.KFZ 101 - Panzerkampfwagen 1 - Ausfuehrung A - Early Production
Originally modelled in cinema4D.
Features:

  - Inside scene: Model without textures

  - No cleaning up necessary, just drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - obj File - lwo file - 3ds file - fbx file Version 2010

The Panzer I is a light tank which was produced in Germany in the 1930s. The name is short for the German Panzerkampfwagen I (armored fighting vehicle mark I), abbreviated PzKpfw I. The tank's official German ordnance inventory designation was SdKfz 101 (special purpose vehicle 101). Design of the Panzer I began in 1932 and mass production in 1934. Although intended only as a training tank to introduce the concept of armored warfare to the German Army, the Panzer I saw combat in Spain during the Spanish Civil War, in Poland, France, Soviet Union and North Africa during the Second World War, and even in China during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Based on experience gathered during the Spanish Civil War, the Panzer I helped shape the German armored corps used to invade Poland in 1939 and France in 1940. By 1941, Panzer I chassis were being reused for production of tank destroyers and assault guns. There were attempts to upgrade the Panzer I throughout its service history, including by foreign nations to increase its lifespan. It continued to serve in the armed forces of Spain until 1954.

description_text:
Aston Martin CC100 rigged 3D model, vray and multiple import formats.

CAR OVERVIEW

The Aston Martin CC100 Speedster is a concept car produced by the British car company Aston Martin to celebrate its 100th anniversary.
The CC100 is powered by a naturally aspirated V12 engine mated to an automated sequential manual 6-speed gearbox, enabling a claimed limited top speed of 180 miles per hour (290 km/h), and acceleration from 0 to 62 miles per hour (100 km/h) in over 4 seconds.
The CC100 is inspired by the 1950s DBR1 with an open split cockpit, cutaway doors and twin rear buttresses, designed by Miles Nurnberger. It is built on the VH platform with a carbonfibre body.

TECHNICAL DETAILS

All exterior and interiors have been modeled on real reference pictures.
Wheels, body, grids, logos, cameras, lights etc are grouped for an easy management of the scene.

Linear workflow gamma 2.2 optimized textures

WHEELS rigged
DOORS grouped with pivot point in the proper position

Lighting and Vray physical cameras ready to render.

Original lowpoly geometry preserved, meshsmooth iter 2 set to work only during render to keep the whole scene extremely easy and fast to navigate in the viewports.

All Materials and 4096x4096 textures included diffuse, specular, bump, opacity, displacement.
Unwrapped UVs

12 textures
1 mat file

max 9 Vray, OBJ, fbx, c4d, 3ds, collada available for download.
OBJ may require textures to be reassigned

max 9 standard materials (mentalray built-in engine) is sold as a separate product

Thank you for reading

description_text:
Detailed model of generic electric car and charging post. This model can be included in any graphic or animation without any copyright issue because it's my own design.
Layered PSD textures are included, that way is easy to change overall graphic design: - Main car body (2048x2048 pixels) - Charging post body (2048x2048 pixels)
MAX format include mental ray 3.5 and scanline materials and illumination.
Plug cap can be closed when car is unplugged.
PDF file with instructions is included.
NOTES: - Modeled in 3dsMax. Two MAX versions are included with standard and mental ray light/materials setup - Images rendered with Mental Ray light setup. - 3DS, FBX and OBJ files need some work on materials, meshes vertex weld and meshsmooth. Instructions included in PDF help file. - This is a polygonal model and is not prepared to be imported into parametric CAD software. - This model is not optimized for 3D printing.
IMPORTANT: Textures separately stored under the 'Textures' file. Unzip them into the mesh fiDle folder.

If you render this file using a different version of this renderer, you may not have the same results as you see on the thumbnails.
|| MATERIALS ||
This model contains V-Ray materials and Standart materialsMaterials are physically correct and renders error freeTextures:2048x2048 (PNG) ConcreteAll objects are UV mappedAll materials are named properly

description_text:
The corner of Biscayne Blvd and NE 4th St
This model was built to reflect current conditions at that intersection and give a realistic environment for architectural projects at that location.  The model includes a near scale representation of the streets, Biscayne Blvd. and NE 4rth Street., the area on the east side and west side of Biscayne Blvd, with a park, a restaurant, a parking garage, sidewalks, trees and bushes, signage. description_text:
This is real-world-size model of Heighborhood Area with 180 Modular Houses made by professional architect.

  - Product dimensions: 570m x 210m

  - Units used: Meters

  - Originally created with 3ds Max 2011

LEVEL OF DETAIL and USAGE

  - Full scene (.max) require powerful workstation (maximum polycount - 113mln), however for the best perfomance all the idential objects are instances - easy to select, disable or convert to proxies 

  - Exchange file formats (.3ds), (.fbx), (.obj) do not contain details (trees, fences, etc.) 

INSTANCES

  - Houses  - 3.164 polygons / 4.573 vertices

  - Details (fence elements, gates and street lights)  - refer to presentation image #3 for the polycount info

  - 2 tree types with random Rotate/Scale transformations 
  - tree01 - 22.182 polygons / 86.998 vertices

  - tree02 - 21.490 polygons / 80.075 vertices

GEOMETRY

  - The models mesh is high quality, with clean edge flow

  - Geometry is carefully tested for holes, flipped normals and overlapping polygons

  - Mesh is low-poly, allows you to easily build up the additional details, edit geometry

  - All similar objects are Instances - easy change or replace

  - Symmetry Modifier applied for all houses

  - Scene objects are organized by layers

PRESENTATION IMAGES

  - All preview images are rendered with 3.20 V-Ray

  - Wire images done with VrayLightMtl + VrayDirt for geometry test

  - VRayHDRI with map VRayCamera are included - product is ready to render out-of-the-box.

MATERIALS

  - This model contains both V-Ray and Standard materials

  - JPG and PNG textures comes in separate archive

  - All objects are UV mapped. All materials are named properly.

ADDITIONAL NOTES
  - No third-party plug-ins needed

description_text:
Cuban House of Diversity is a building in the city of Camaguey. It is old historic structure of hispanic neo-classic culture period. This is a high quality next gen game model. This model is midpoly and optimized, it has PBR textures packed in R,G,B channels. The object is UV-unwrapped and has 8 texture sets with 4K textures. Model has manually created LODs and collision
Features:-High quality mid poly model. It has real world scale-This museum refers to a real world object-Model isn't intended to be subdivided, as it is a game ready object-4K textures-Textures can be modified-Model is fully textured with all materials applied.-All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.-3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named.-There several .max files for different 3ds Max versions.Some of them have standard materials, because they are designed to be exported into game engines.There are also VRay versions with VRay materials applied. You can see both VRay and PBR renders above-No special plugin needed to open scene.-Objects contain manually created LODs (Level of details). Building has basic LOD as well as LOD1 and LOD2-Model also has collision (see notes)-Model is totally UV unwrapped and uses unique textures mostly. -Texture archive consists of PBR and VRay textures.-There is a folder with TGA files inside. Those textures are optimized for game engines. It has Albedo map, Normal map and specific map which has Metallic, Roughness and Ambient Occlussion packed in RGB channles accordingly.-Unreal Engine files are included-Shaders are set up in Unreal Engine 4.17
File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2016 V-Ray and standard materials scenes

  - 3ds Max 2015 V-Ray and standard materials scenes

  - 3ds Max 2014 with standard materials only

  - OBJ (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2016

  - UASSET

Every model has been checked with the appropriate software.
Warning: Depending on which software package you are using, the exchange formats (.obj, .3ds and .fbx) may not match the preview images exactly. Due to the nature of these formats, there may be some textures that have to be loaded by hand and possibly triangulated geometry.
Textures Formats:-4096*4096 (.tga) - Base Color, Normal, MetallicRoughnessAO (packed into one image in different RGB channels) - 8 texture sets-4096*4096 (.png) - Base Color, Normal, Glossiness, Specular - 8 texture sets
NOTES:

  - you can download each file format separately or you can download 'camaguey.zip' which contains everything. I strongly recommend you to download the model as packed with textures in this archive

  - 'camaguey_textures.zip' archive contains 4K textures in it.

  - model intended to be used in a street line so side walls are not necessary

  - there are 5 versions of scene in 3ds max
